description: Request a service ticket for an account's SPN and crack it offline to recover the account's password.

telemetry.detail: Kerberos service ticket (TGS-REQ) request - watch for RC4 (0x17) encryption type; a targeted single-SPN request is hard to distinguish from normal ticket volume.
Requesting many SPNs at once (mass roast) is a strong signal; a single targeted request blends in.

prerequisite_privilege: Any authenticated domain user (service tickets are requestable by anyone)
abuse_primitive: Rubeus kerberoast /user:<spn account>, then hashcat -m 13100 offline.
notes: Targeted single-account roasting is quiet by default; the loud version is requesting every SPN at once. Cracking happens offline (no telemetry). Score assumes a targeted request against one account.
